description: Einleitepunkte der Kläranlagen > 2000 EW, Bericht 2024 is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by docs.umweltbundesamt.at. discharge point of municipal wastewater treatment plants with a population value equal to or greater than 2,000 p.e. on the graphene of the total water network; Data status: EU Urban Waste Water Directive - 91/271/EEC - Austrian Report 2024 (reference year 2022). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Starting points of sewage treatment plants > 2000 p.e., 2024 report" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Entsorgung, Kläranlagen, Einleitepunkt, HighValueDataset, Abwasserentsorgung. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
